Ru.bar_b_note: A readable blue spined dragon with a clear face, but A's faint end drops to a flat grey-beige material and its faint mid hangs above a detached shadow blob, while B's faint end curls into an unreadable knot; neither is at Palworld finish.

Ya.bar_b_note: A clean teal lizard with a cream frill, but it is low and long, barely clears the trainer's height, and its small, mid-tone silhouette lacks the finish of the owner bar creatures.

Th.bar_b_note: The image matches Ya frame for frame (same teal frilled lizard) and has the same problem: it is low, small against the ruler, and has a flat mid-tone finish.

Pv.bar_b_note: The bear carries it: real fur mass, violet storm veins, about twice the trainer's height and a grounded sprawl at faint end, which puts it on the owner bar.

Uv.bar_b_note: The raptor reads as chrome-white with blown, bright feather edges instead of slate and tan plumage, it stands only about as tall as the trainer, and the hit react frame is a thin vertical sliver that loses the bird.

Ow.bar_b_note: A murky brown-green forest floor with no purple storm sky or lightning, flat magenta telegraph rings and a HUD that covers about a third of every frame, plus (on A) the camera buried in canopy; it does not read as a Palworld-class boss fight.

Ot.bar_b_note: The standing ram is on the owner bar, but the faint poses break it: on A the limbs splay and the body twists apart, and on B it collapses into a legless fleece pillow with oversized horn coils.

Ai.bar_b_note: The wolf's dark violet fur and long silhouette carry it to Palworld finish, held back by storm arcs that blur into a purple wash rather than reading as bright lines.

Eg.bar_b_note: A clear, rideable teal otter at good scale with a believable ridden pose, but the fur is a single mid-tone teal without the value breakup and material detail of the owner bar.

Fi.bar_b_note: A warm, appealing grandfather in an earthy green and brown outfit that matches the key art palette; his rounded, cartoon face is the only part that sits apart from the naturalistic creature style.

top_changes.change: Ow storm-forest fight: add camera collision or fade for trunks and canopy (A i11-i16), lift exposure and add the fixed purple storm sky and white-violet lightning, replace the flat magenta telegraph rings with real objects and impacts, and shrink the HUD panels so they stop covering the fight.

Faint poses and materials: keep limbs and the full material through faint (Ru A faint end goes grey; Ot faint becomes a legless blob or a twisted body; Ru B faint end knots up) and keep every faint grounded and readable.

Bring the outliers to the owner bar: replace the chrome-white raptor material in Uv with matte slate and tan feathers, sharpen the Ai storm arcs into thin bright lines, and scale Ya/Th/Ru/Uv so each clearly stands taller than the 1.80 m trainer.
